macro_context.market_sentiment: Strongly bullish: S&P 500 at 7,377 (+0.17%), Nasdaq at 25,977 (+0.53%), Dow crossed 50,000 for the first time. Markets at/near record highs driven by AI earnings beats (AMD +17.77%, Supermicro +24.5%, Nvidia +5.5%) and growing hopes of a US-Iran peace deal dragging oil back toward $94 from $100+.
macro_context.fed_outlook: Fed held rates at 3.5%-3.75% on April 29, 2026 (third consecutive hold), with an unusual 8-4 dissent split — most dissents since October 1992. Median FOMC projection: 1 rate cut in 2026. Inflation remains elevated partly due to global energy prices from the Iran conflict. Jerome Powell's tenure as Chair ended at this meeting.
macro_context.geopolitical: US-Iran conflict is in its third month, disrupting Strait of Hormuz shipping and keeping Brent crude near $97-100/bbl. On May 4, UAE intercepted Iranian missiles and markets dipped. By May 6-7, peace negotiations accelerated — Iran expected to deliver its 14-point response to the US peace proposal, lifting risk sentiment strongly.
